newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers steady as rest of Europe drops.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers steady as rest of Europe drops.

text.p: ARA bunkers prices recovered from an early slip on Tuesday, holding at Monday's closing levels, while bunkers in the rest of Europe dropped, spurring healthy demand, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil traded in a range $120/$121 in late activity after barges recovered from a $3 slip in the morning. A couple of larger enquiries emerged, but overall demand was lacklustre.
Hamburg prices were down about $1 to $127 fob. One supplier also offered somewhat lower and drew in a healthy volume of enquiries.
Mediterranean prices were on average $2 a tonne lower and most brokers and suppliers were busy fielding calls from interested shipowners.
Some suppliers said they expected further weakness later in the week.
Further east, Egyptian prices were down $2/$3, while Fujairah dropped $4 a tonne to around $111. Both areas drew a large number of enquiries.
